text: Researchers note that evaluating the effectiveness of low emission zone policies like ULEZ is methodologically challenging, as different evaluation methods have produced discrepancies of several-fold magnitude in estimated effects.
JECFA의 재평가에서 아스파탐의 1일 허용섭취량(ADI)은 기존 0–40 mg/kg 체중으로 재확인되었으며 변경되지 않았다.
Under Article 54, the authorised representative may terminate the mandate if the provider fails to comply with the AI Act

TfL reported that the compliance rate of vehicles registered to addresses within inner, central and outer London has been lower than the compliance rate of vehicles observed (detected by camera) in each of those zones.
The academic study found no significant benefits of ULEZ on PM2.5 concentrations, which remained well above WHO air quality guidelines.

The Commission and the AI Board have confirmed that the GPAI Code of Practice is an adequate voluntary tool for providers of general-purpose AI models to demonstrate compliance with the AI Act, without specifying a date for this confirmation in this source.
Providers of GPAI models with systemic risk owe additional Article 55 obligations covering model evaluation, systemic-risk mitigation, serious-incident reporting, and cybersecurity protection.
TfL의 1주년 보고서에 따르면 런던 외곽(outer London) 지역의 도로변 NO2 농도는 ULEZ 확장 첫 해에 평균 최대 4.8% 낮아졌다.

Under Article 53(2) AI Act, the obligations to maintain Annex XI technical documentation and to provide Annex XII information to downstream providers do not apply to providers of general-purpose AI models released under a free and open-source licence that allows access, usage, modification and distribution, and whose parameters (including weights), architecture, and usage information are made publicly available.

Article 54(1) of the AI Act requires providers of general-purpose AI models established in third countries to appoint, by written mandate, an authorised representative established in the Union prior to placing the model on the Union market

Under Article 54, the authorised representative must keep a copy of the technical documentation specified in Annex XI at the disposal of the AI Office and national competent authorities for a period of 10 years after the general-purpose AI model has been placed on the market
Under Article 113 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, Chapter V (general-purpose AI models) applies from 2 August 2025.
Providers of general-purpose AI models, even when exempt under the open-source exemption, are not exempt from the public training-content summary obligation under Article 53(1)(d) AI Act.
Per the Commission's Guidelines on the scope of GPAI obligations, a model is considered GPAI if it is trained with more than 10^23 FLOP and can generate language.

The Commission and the Member States confirmed that the GPAI Code of Practice, developed by independent experts, is an adequate voluntary tool for GPAI model providers to demonstrate compliance with their AI Act obligations.
런던 전체의 차량 운행 대수는 2024년 9월까지 1년간 일평균 197만 대에서 210만 대로 증가했다.
The same study reported no significant benefits of ULEZ on fine particulate matter (PM2.5) concentrations, with NO2 remaining well above the WHO air quality guideline.

Under Article 54, the mandate given to the authorised representative empowers it to verify that the technical documentation specified in Annex XI has been drawn up and that obligations under Article 53 (and, where applicable, Article 55) have been fulfilled by the provider
Per regulation-ai.eu's amendment record, the 2026 Digital Omnibus extended the high-risk AI deadlines but left all other AI Act deadlines unchanged.
AO Shearman의 AI Act 해설 기사는 AI Act가 'AI system'과 'GPAI model'을 규율한다고 설명한다.

IARC classified aspartame as Group 2B ('possibly carcinogenic to humans') citing 'limited evidence' for carcinogenicity in humans, while JECFA, in the same joint release, reaffirmed the acceptable daily intake of 40 mg/kg body weight for aspartame.
Under the AI Act, providers of general-purpose AI models posing systemic risks must notify the Commission of those models.

According to a timeline summary, obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models began to apply on 2 August 2025, which is a separate milestone from the 2 February 2025 date on which most prohibited AI practices and the AI literacy obligation began to apply.
GPAI provider obligations under the EU AI Act entered into application on 2 August 2025, with enforcement action against non-compliance beginning 2 August 2026.
WHO EHC 240 Chapter 5 (2020년 2판)는 POD(point of departure) 결정 방법으로 NOAEL/LOAEL 접근법과 BMD(benchmark dose) 접근법을 별도 하위 절(5.3.2, 5.3.3)에서 다루고 있다.
scikit-learn CI는 Python 3.13 free-threaded 작업을 위해 pandas의 개발용(dev) wheel에 의존하기 시작했다.
PostgreSQL과 Elasticsearch에 대한 '듀얼 라이트' 방식에서, 두 쓰기 사이에 애플리케이션이 크래시하면 Elasticsearch 업데이트가 조용히 유실된다.

An IARC Monographs webpage (associated with Volume 134 on aspartame, which links to the Aspartame Q&A) explicitly contrasts IARC's hazard-identification mandate with JECFA's risk-assessment mandate, stating that IARC assesses carcinogenic potential (hazard identification) while JECFA updates its risk assessment including the Acceptable Daily Intake and exposure assessment.
JECFA는 역학적 근거가 '설득력이 없다(not convincing)'고 평가하며 아스파탐과 암 사이에 일관된 연관성이 없다는 결론으로 안전성을 재확인했다.

The Digital Omnibus, which reopened Article 113 and postponed high-risk AI system application dates to 2027/2028, left the 2 August 2026 application date for the general-purpose AI enforcement machinery (including Article 101 fining powers) unchanged.
PostgreSQL과 Elasticsearch에 대한 '듀얼 라이트(dual-write)' 방식에서, PostgreSQL 쓰기 성공 후 Elasticsearch 쓰기가 실패하면 두 시스템에 걸친 트랜잭션이 없어 데이터 불일치가 발생한다.
The same IARC Monographs webpage explicitly states the IARC Monographs program conducts hazard identification according to a published Preamble and has never evaluated aspartame.
Elasticsearch RRF's Enterprise-only gating has held since it first appeared as a technical preview in 8.8 (May 2023), through its 8.16 GA release (November 2024), and into the 9.x line.
In the same Article 113(2) text, point (d) sets Articles 102 to 110 to apply from 27 July 2026, and this sub-point does not assign a specific application date to Article 101.

WHO EHC 240 (2020년 2판) Chapter 5의 5.2절은 'Dose-response assessment'이며, 하위에 5.2.1 Basic concepts of dose-response assessment, 5.2.1.1 Dose, 5.2.1.2 Response, 5.2.1.3 Use of dose-response assessment to develop risk assessment advice로 구성되어 있다.
A GPAI model is presumed to have systemic risk under Article 51(2) when its cumulative training compute exceeds 10^25 FLOPs.
The 2023 ULEZ expansion showed no detectable impact on NO2 concentrations in London.
AI Act 제3조의 'provider' 정의(제3조 제3호)는 'AI 시스템' 개발자와 '범용 AI 모델' 개발자를 'or'로 병렬 연결하여 별개의 규율 대상으로 명시한다.

The animal evidence consisted of an increased incidence of tumours observed in two species (mouse and rat), of both sexes, across three published studies, though the Working Group noted concerns over study design, interpretation, and reporting.
pydevtools에 따르면 CPython은 --disable-gil 빌드 플래그로 GIL 없는 인터프리터를 컴파일하며, 이때 객체 헤더 변경(biased reference counting 지원)으로 인해 free-threaded 빌드는 표준 빌드와 ABI 호환되지 않아 C 확장을 재빌드해야 하고 별도의 't' 접미사 ABI 태그로 wheel이 배포된다.

TfL's published ULEZ compliance data page states that for outer London in September 2024, 96.7% of vehicles subject to the ULEZ seen driving in the expanded area on an average day complied with ULEZ emissions standards.
The linear retriever added in Elasticsearch 8.18 / 9.0 is gated the same way as RRF, also requiring the Enterprise tier.
The date 2 August 2027 corresponds to the original deadline for high-risk AI systems embedded in regulated products, which the Digital Omnibus package moved to 2 August 2028, a 12-month extension.
IARC's Group 2B classification of aspartame was based specifically on limited evidence for hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer) in humans.
On November 19, 2025, the European Commission officially adopted a proposal for the Digital Omnibus package, rather than a finally enacted and published amending act.
According to Tencent Cloud documentation, the retriever-based syntax for RRF in Elasticsearch has been officially available since version 8.16.
The Article 53(2) open-source exemption is nullified once a GPAI model is classified as posing systemic risk under Article 51, regardless of its licence type or release format.
IARC 작업반은 아스파탐을 간세포암(hepatocellular carcinoma)에 대한 제한된 인체 근거를 바탕으로 '인체 발암 가능물질(Group 2B)'로 분류했다.

The human evidence IARC relied on consisted of only three studies on artificially sweetened beverage consumption, each showing a positive association with liver cancer risk, but chance, bias, or confounding could not be ruled out.
확장 모듈은 GIL 비활성화 지원을 명시적으로 표시해야 하며, 이를 하지 않으면 임포트 시 경고가 발생하고 런타임에 GIL이 다시 활성화된다.
pgvector의 벡터 기능은 데이터베이스마다 'CREATE EXTENSION vector;' 명령으로 명시적으로 활성화해야 사용할 수 있다.

The Digital Omnibus postpones the application of rules on high-risk AI systems, including watermarking obligations for AI-generated content moving to 2 December 2026 (from a previously proposed 2 February 2027 date), high-risk use case AI system obligations moving to 2 December 2027, and obligations on high-risk AI systems used as safety components in products covered by EU sectoral legislation moving to 2 August 2028.
Python 3.13에서는 python3.13t 빌드가 공식적으로 '실험용'으로만 존재해 프로덕션에 투입할 수 없었던 반면, Python 3.14에서는 이 free-threaded 빌드가 공식적으로 지원되는 단계로 승격되었다
pgvector는 PostgreSQL에서 정확(exact) 최근접 이웃 탐색과 근사(approximate) 최근접 이웃 탐색을 모두 지원하며, half-precision, binary, sparse 벡터 타입과 L2, inner product, cosine, L1, Hamming, Jaccard 총 6종의 거리 메트릭을 제공한다.
Citus 확장은 코디네이터 노드가 쿼리를 라우팅하고 해시 키로 샤드 파티션을 분산시켜 PostgreSQL을 여러 워커 노드에 걸친 분산 데이터베이스로 전환하며 JOIN을 병렬화한다.
In Elasticsearch's RRF retriever, the rank_window_size parameter controls how many results from each sub-query participate in fusion, defaulting to 100.
The Digital Omnibus on AI, published as EU Regulation 1744/2026 in the Official Journal, becomes applicable on 27 July 2026.
CPU-bound 벤치마크인 Mandelbrot 집합 계산, 행렬 곱셈, 소수 체를 실행한 결과, Mandelbrot 집합 계산과 소수 체는 합리적인 확장을 보인 반면 행렬 곱셈은 매우 나쁜 확장을 보였다
Pre-filtering(후보 선택 전/중에 필터를 적용하는 방식)은 일반적으로 재현율을 보호하지만, 필터가 제한적일 때 지연시간을 증가시킬 수 있다.
IARC states that its Monographs hazard classification (e.g., Group assignments) does not indicate the level of cancer risk associated with exposure.
Python 3.13 'What's New' 문서는 free-threaded 빌드에 대해 'substantial single-threaded performance hit'이 있다고 언급하지만 구체적 퍼센트 수치는 제시하지 않는다.

Per the Commission's GPAI guidelines, the voluntary Code of Practice and the mandatory template for the public summary of training content have different legal status: the Code of Practice is voluntary, while the training-content summary template is mandatory.
AO Shearman의 분석에 따르면 AI Act는 AI system과 GPAI model을 별개의 규율 대상으로 규제하며, GPAI model 외의 다른 AI 모델(예: 머신러닝·NLP 모델)은 AI Act에서 구체적으로 규율되지 않는다.

In a February 2026 FOI response, TfL confirmed it holds some ULEZ compliance-related information and stated that to establish whether a vehicle is compliant with the ULEZ emission standards it predominantly uses the vehicle data held by the DVLA.

The general-purpose AI model obligations (binding since August 2, 2025, with pre-existing models required to comply by August 2, 2027) are among the provisions that did not change following the Digital Omnibus.
The European Commission published its non-binding Guidelines on the scope of the obligations for general-purpose AI models on 18 July 2025.
Under Article 54, open-source general-purpose AI models are exempt from the authorised representative requirements unless they are classified as general-purpose AI models with systemic risks
EU AI Act 서비스 데스크 FAQ에 따르면, 제3조 제1항의 'AI 시스템' 정의와 제3조 제63항의 'GPAI 모델' 정의는 AI 에이전트를 포괄하기에 충분하다고 설명한다.

A secondary legal-compliance source (sota.io) states that Article 111(3) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 requires providers of GPAI models placed on the EU market before 2 August 2025 to comply with the GPAI chapter obligations by 2 August 2027.
As of September 2024, TfL reported that 96.7% of vehicles subject to ULEZ seen driving in the expanded (outer London) area on an average day complied with ULEZ emissions standards.
According to a separate compliance-tracking source, Chapter V GPAI model obligations under the EU AI Act have applied generally since 2 August 2025.

The Digital Omnibus package's proposed AI Act changes described in available sources concern high-risk AI system obligations (e.g., a 'stop-the-clock' mechanism tied to Annex III timelines with a long-stop of December 2, 2027).
Python 3.13 공식 free-threading HOWTO 문서는 free-threaded 빌드가 실험적 상태이며 단일 스레드 성능에서 상당한(substantial) 저하가 예상된다고 명시하지만, 구체적인 수치는 제시하지 않는다.
Under the EU AI Act, obligations for providers of GPAI models enter into application on 2 August 2025.

IARC's classification of aspartame as Group 2B rested on three evidentiary pillars: limited evidence for cancer in humans, limited evidence for cancer in experimental animals, and limited mechanistic evidence.

General-purpose AI model providers under the AI Act owe Article 53 obligations consisting of Annex XI technical documentation, Annex XII downstream-provider information, a copyright policy, and a training-data summary.
The 'Digital Omnibus on AI' was published in the Official Journal of the European Union as EU Regulation 1744/2026 and becomes applicable on 27 July 2026.

Providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk must comply with all the obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models regardless of whether the model is released as open-source, meaning the open-source exemption does not apply to such models.

A study found that the 2019 central London ULEZ produced NO2 reductions (19.6% at traffic sites and 8.2% at urban background sites), whereas the 2023 London-wide ULEZ expansion showed no detectable impact on NO2.

Under Article 53(1)(d) of the AI Act, GPAI model providers must publicly disclose a sufficiently detailed summary of the data used to train their models, an obligation for which the European Commission published an Explanatory Notice and Template, applicable from 2 August 2025.
pgvector는 PostgreSQL에 기본 내장되지 않고 별도로 컴파일·설치해야 하는 확장(extension)이며, PostgreSQL 13 이상 버전을 지원한다.
TfL의 1주년 분석에 대해 TfL 관계자들은 ULEZ 확장의 효과가 'Home Counties'까지 '퍼져나가고(rippling beyond London)' 있다고 언급했다.
아스파탐 평가 결과에 대해 '일반적으로 사용되는 용량에서는 안전성이 주요 우려사항이 아니다'라는 언급이 있었다
IARC Monographs 프로그램 사무국과 WHO/JECFA 사무국 간의 긴밀한 협력이 두 평가의 순서와 결합되어 아스파탐의 건강 영향에 대한 포괄적 평가를 가능하게 했다고 명시되어 있다.
PostgreSQL full-text search has been built in since version 8.3, including stemming, stop-word removal, ranking, phrase queries, multi-language dictionaries and highlighting, all with index support.

According to a third-party guide, PostgreSQL ships a complete full-text search system — lexer, stemmer, stop-word lists, language dictionaries, relevance ranking, and query syntax — without requiring any extensions.
pandas 프로젝트는 Python 3.13 free-threaded 빌드를 지원하기 위해 필요한 모든 작업을 추적하는 이슈를 자체적으로 운영하고 있다.

The Commission issued its assessment of the GPAI Code of Practice in the legal form of a 'Commission Opinion', titled 'Commission Opinion on the assessment of the General-Purpose AI Code of Practice'.
Python 3.13의 free-threaded 빌드는 실험적 상태이며, 버그가 존재하고 단일 스레드 성능이 상당히 저하될 것으로 예상된다.
Python Steering Council이 PEP 703을 수용하며 밝힌 단계적 도입 계획에 따르면 Phase I은 실험적 단계로, 빌드타임 옵션으로 활성화되는 free-threaded 빌드이며 어디에서도 기본 설치가 되어서는 안 되고 프로덕션 사용으로 지원되지 않으며 되돌려질 수 있다고 명시된다.
py-free-threading.github.io에 따르면 CPython 3.13은 실험적(experimental) free-threaded 빌드를 출시했으며, PEP 779 수용과 함께 Python 3.14부터는 free-threaded 인터프리터가 더 이상 실험적으로 간주되지 않지만 아직 기본 인터프리터 빌드는 아니다.
이번 평가는 JECFA가 아스파탐을 평가한 세 번째 사례였다.
Chapter V (general-purpose AI models), Chapter VII (governance) and Chapter XII (penalties) of the AI Act apply from 2 August 2025, twelve months after entry into force.

Article 4 of the AI Act, effective since 2 February 2025, requires providers and deployers of AI systems to ensure a sufficient level of AI literacy among personnel, and this obligation applies to all AI systems, not only high-risk ones.
AI Act 제3조 제1항은 'AI system'을 특정 다층적 기능 요소(자율성 수준, 배치 후 적응성, 명시·암묵적 목표에 따른 입력으로부터의 출력 추론)를 포함하는 기계 기반 시스템으로 정의한다.
IARC의 역할은 아스파탐의 발암 위해성(hazard) 식별 평가이며, 이를 뒤이어 JECFA가 1일 섭취 허용량(ADI) 재검토 및 식이 노출 평가를 포함한 위험성(risk) 평가를 갱신하는 역할 분담 구조이다.
IARC와 JECFA 두 평가의 결과는 2023년 7월 14일에 함께 발표될 예정이었다.
Providers of GPAI models that meet or approach the 10^25 FLOPs computational threshold must notify the European Commission within two weeks of the model meeting that threshold.
IARC's Working Group classified aspartame as possibly carcinogenic to humans (Group 2B).

eipa.eu 블로그는 AI Act 제3조 제63항이 GPAI 모델을 'significant generality'를 보이고 모델이 시장에 출시되는 방식과 무관하게 다양한 범위의 별개 작업을 능숙하게 수행할 수 있으며 다양한 다운스트림 시스템이나 애플리케이션에 통합될 수 있는 모델로 정의한다고 인용하며, 이 인용문 자체에 생략 부호(…)가 포함되어 있어 조문 전체가 아닌 일부 문언임을 나타낸다.

An academic study found that the 2019 central London ULEZ led to 19.6% and 8.2% (~13.3 and 2.7 µg/m³) reductions in NO2 at traffic and urban background sites respectively in the three months after implementation, with positive spillover effects across Inner and Outer London.
Under Article 113 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, Chapters I and II (general provisions and prohibited AI practices) apply from 2 February 2025, an earlier date than Chapter V.
Elasticsearch's Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) retriever is gated to the Enterprise license tier.
The same academic study found that the 2023 city-wide ULEZ expansion showed no detectable impact on NO2 concentrations.

TfL data for outer London in September 2024 recorded a daily figure of 1,868,000 total vehicles detected, of which 1,820,000 were compliant and 49,000 were non-compliant, giving a 97.4% compliance rate in that zone.
This 2023 evaluation was the first time IARC had assessed aspartame's carcinogenicity, whereas it was the third time JECFA had evaluated it.
IARC는 아스파탐을 'possibly carcinogenic to humans (Group 2B)'로 분류한 근거로, 간세포암종(hepatocellular carcinoma)에 대한 사람에서의 제한된 증거(limited evidence)를 들었다
Citus 기반 Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL 클러스터는 여러 노드에 걸쳐 데이터를 자동으로 샤딩하고 쿼리를 병렬로 실행하여 워크로드를 효율적으로 분산시키는 반면, Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server는 네이티브 샤딩을 지원하지 않고 모든 쓰기가 단일 프라이머리 노드로 전달된다.
IARC Monographs Programme's stated purpose is to identify carcinogenic hazards, per IARC's own description of the programme.
JECFA는 평가에서 아동 및 성인의 평균 및 고섭취군 식이노출 추정치가 ADI를 초과하지 않는다고 판단하여 아스파탐 섭취가 건강상 우려를 야기하지 않는다고 결론지었다.
